description_en: Call SaveBatchTaskForTransferProhibitionLock to enable or disable the transfer prohibition lock for multiple domain names
description_zh: 调用SaveBatchTaskForTransferProhibitionLock提交批量禁止转移锁任务
kebab_example: aliyun domain save-batch-task-for-transfer-prohibition-lock --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --lang en --status false --domain-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SaveBatchTaskForTransferProhibitionLock

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message that is returned if the request fails. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文；
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the transfer prohibition lock. Valid values:

true: Enable the transfer prohibition lock.

false: Disable the transfer prohibition lock
parameters.help_zh:
开启关闭状态。取值：
true：开启；
false：关闭。
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The domain names for which you want to enable or disable the transfer prohibition lock
parameters.name: domain_name
